lines.t: (Atmospheric pads, vinyl crackle, distant vocal hums)
(YahuShua...)
[Verse 1]
(Minimalist, heavy atmosphere, soft 808 heartbeat)
In the silence, before the dawn
Before the breath had found my lungs
You were calling, calling me
Out of the deep eternity
Not distant, not far away
Stepped right into dust and clay
Heaven wrapped in flesh and bone
And suddenly, I’m not alone
[Pre-Chorus]
(Filter sweep, rising tension, airy ad-libs)
The veil is thin, the sky bends low
The Unseen... (the Unseen) ...now I know
[Chorus]
(Explosive but slow, wide stereo field, cinematic percussion)
You said, “I AM—the Way, the Truth, the Life”
Your heartbeat pulsing into mine
Life has a Name, burning in my soul
YahuShua, You have made me whole
The Kingdom’s here, it’s falling now
I feel Your glory all around
Captured in grace, lost in the flame
Grace and Truth—forever Your Name
[Verse 2]
(Deep bass, rhythmic but spacious)
Creation trembles at Your voice
Yet still You give my heart a choice
To enter in, to see Your face
To be undone inside Your grace
The stars bow down, the oceans roar
Yet You stand knocking at my door
Infinity within Your eyes
And still You see my hidden life (my hidden life...)
You draw so near, I can’t escape
This holy love, this sacred weight
You said, “I AM—the Way, the Truth, the Life”
Your heartbeat pulsing into mine
Life has a Name, burning in my soul
YahuShua, You have made me whole
The Kingdom’s here, it’s falling now
I feel Your glory all around
Captured in grace, lost in the flame
Grace and Truth—forever Your Name
[Bridge]
(Half-time feel, stripped back, focus on "divine" whisper)
Heaven is here, it’s breaking through
Every shadow erased by You
The vast unknown now lives in me
Your presence is my reality
I’m caught, I’m held, I’m overcome
By the rising of the Holy One
Not just a whisper, not just a sign
But living breath—divine, divine
[Final Chorus]
(High energy, layered harmonies)
You are the Way, the Truth, the Life
The everlasting, endless light
Life has a Name, and I’m calling it now
YahuShua—every knee will bow
The Kingdom’s here, it’s falling now
I feel Your glory all around
Captured in grace, forever I’ll stay
In the arms of Truth, in the light of Your Way
[Outro]
(Fading reverb, lone piano notes, whispered vocals)
Life has a Name… (Life has a Name)
Grace has a Name…
Truth has a Name…
YahuShua.
(YahuShua...)
